title: Identify artists who have illustrated at least one card that is both textle
question: Identify artists who have illustrated at least one card that is both textless and part of an incredibly powerful foil (where both cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId are not null), and whose cards include at least one with a 2015 frame version and an EDHRec rank below 100. For these artists, list all foreign languages in which any of their cards have non-null flavor text.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT fd."XCL_077"
FROM foreign_data AS fd
INNER JOIN cards AS c ON fd."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072"
WHERE c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c1."XCL_002" FROM cards AS c1
    WHERE c1."XCL_022" = 1
      AND c1."XCL_007" IS NOT NULL
      AND c1."XCL_006" IS NOT NULL
)
AND c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c2."XCL_002" FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE c2."XCL_019" = '2015'
      AND c2."XCL_014" < 100
)
AND fd."XCL_076" IS NOT NULL
